description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Meta Llama 3.3 70B, strong general chat with tool calling. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/large and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $0.879 per million input and $6.759 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0219. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (tool calling, streaming supported), up to 2048 output tokens. Costs $0.0219 USDC per call (x402).
